init_d_path.description: Path to the directory containing LSB-compliant init scripts.

default_runlevel.description: Default runlevel used when LSB headers are ambiguous or missing runlevel info.

debug.description: Enable verbose output for debugging dependency resolution.

extra_init_dirs.description: Additional directories (beyond /etc/init.d) to scan for LSB header information.

items.description: Absolute path to an extra init script directory.

dependency_overrides.description: Custom dependency rule overrides for specific init scripts. Use sparingly—override only when LSB headers are incorrect or need manual tuning.

script.description: Name of the init script (without path).

action.description: Action to take: `+add` to force inclusion, `-remove` to exclude, `*replace` to override.

ignore_missing_tags.description: If true, skip scripts that lack required LSB header tags (e.g., `Default-Start`). Otherwise, insserv fails on missing headers.

database_path.description: Path to insserv’s runtime dependency database (cache).

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth during dependency resolution. Prevents stack overflow on circular references.
